summary: Every hujson.Parse in policy code parses a private copy; Standardize and Format rewrite the parsed buffer in place.
reason: Validating a candidate policy standardized the same buffer that was then written, which would have blanked every comment in the live policy file on policy add-entry --yes.
validated_outcome: TestPolicyHelpersNeverMutateInput and TestPolicyAddEntryWritesWithIfMatchAndBackup (written policy keeps all comments).
